motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Alright, time to see how things really are!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: You go first, I'll cover the tail end.

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Need my help with that? Don't worry, what happened at the café was an accident! I didn't know Gr G36's headband would break so easily.

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: I'm back. Do you like this souvenir?

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt... Let me nap, talk to you later.

motions.name: login
motions.line: You finally made it back. I've been waiting for a while.

motions.name: login
motions.line: You finally made it back. I've been waiting for a while.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: The old toy? I got bored with it and chucked it. More importantly, Commander, what new stuff have you got? Show me and let's study it together?

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Unspoken rules are part of the game, too.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: A newbie's here? Let's go see them together!

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: It's okay to be nostalgic, but not everyone has to feel that way, right? Some people look into the past, then someone must look into the future. Which are you, Commander?

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Hehe, what new things will I find this time?

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Got something cool to show me, Commander? <>An oath? Oh, sure! In return, please keep this certificate I ordered. <>An oath is meant to be exchanged, right?

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Commander, I've been very interested in swimming lately... Wanna go together? What, my body isn't very waterproof? Then I'll just play outside the water!
